title: Chapter 106 Spider Boss
content:
Chapter 106 Spider Boss

Around Wana Village, there were piles of beast corpses, emitting a strong smell of blood.

In the pile of corpses, several bosses and Wang Shuo's generals were fighting fiercely.

Wang Shuo, who had collected the spoils, swept through the remaining bosses one by one.

White wolf, tiger, spider, wild bull, beetle, giant ape.

Each one looked difficult to deal with.

At this time, the militia and cavalry squads were under great pressure.

20 militiamen, 3 of them had already died.

They could only take turns to resist damage and then take drugs to replenish their health.

Although the cavalry squad had better levels and equipment, they were fewer in number and faced two bosses directly, which was also extremely dangerous at this time.

In the end, Wang Shuo chose the spider boss and chose to reduce the pressure on the cavalry squad.

"You focus on dealing with the giant ape, and leave this spider to me."

The spider boss in front of him was 4 meters tall, and his 8 long legs with thick heads were covered with fine hair.

A closer look revealed that it was not fluff at all, but steel needles.

Her face was full of ferocity, revealing her fierceness.

"Just you?" The spider boss sneered contemptuously, with a very contemptuous tone.

Without seeing her move, a spider silk drew a beautiful arc in the air and rushed straight to Wang Shuo's face.

Wang Shuo did not dare to despise it, and immediately focused his attention to deal with it, moving his body quickly to the left, barely avoiding the attack.

In order not to be tied up by the spider silk, Wang Shuo had to move around, rolling left and right, and constantly avoiding it.

Suddenly, the spider boss pounced, opened its huge mouthparts, aimed at Wang Shuo, and bit down.

At this critical moment, Wang Shuo rolled forward and came to the spider's abdomen.

The eight thick long legs around it were like eight pillars, supporting a huge body.

Wang Shuo entered her blind spot at this time, and he did not hesitate to stab upwards with the flaming spear.

The spear pierced the hard shell of the spider's abdomen.

The spider boss felt pain, slightly bent her legs, and jumped suddenly.

The spear was pulled out of her body, leaving a fist-sized hole.

A foul-smelling fluid fell in the air.

Suddenly, the bloody air was mixed with a foul smell.

"Ah!"

"I'm going to kill you!"

The spider boss screamed, with anger in her eyes, and her eyes were about to spit fire.

Although this attack only caused 100 points of damage to the spider boss, it was not worth mentioning for her more than 8,000 health points.

But the damage was not great, and it was extremely insulting.

A small human actually caused her harm, which she could not tolerate.

In an instant, a huge spider web spewed out from her mouth.

It rushed towards Wang Shuo's head.

Wang Shuo looked at the big web above his head and had no time to dodge, because the range of the spider web was too large, with a radius of more than ten meters.

Wang Shuo secretly groaned in his heart and could only gamble.

"Breath of Flame."

He wanted to try to see if he could use this skill to burn a hole in the spider web.

After a moment, Wang Shuo showed disappointment on his face.

His skill failed to destroy the strong spider web.

Immediately, he was trapped in the web.

At this moment, a bronze spear shot by Li Jianguo pierced directly into the spider's body.

"-2000"

The spider boss was directly repelled more than ten meters by the huge force.

"Well done."

The spider boss was repelled, finally giving Wang Shuo a chance to breathe.

Just when Wang Shuo stood up and planned to clean the spider web on his body.

Four figures quickly approached.
